question:
Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

We should try to __pacify __the situation and not _____ it further.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aggravate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pacify"** means to bring or restore to a state of peace or tranquillity; to calm or soothe. (शांत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The mother pacified her crying child by rocking him gently.
 
 
 
• **"Aggravate" **refers to making a problem, injury, or offense worse or more serious; it is the opposite of pacifying. (बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **Constant interruptions will only aggravate the situation and not help solve the problem.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Pacify'** is **'Aggravate'**.

Therefore, the complete sentence is: *We should try to **pacify**__ the situation and not __**aggravate**__ it further.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mitigate **(कम करना): To make less severe, serious, or painful.

 
 
• **Example:** The government took measures to mitigate the economic impact of the pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Standardise **(मानकीकरण करना ): To make things of the same type all have the same basic features.
 
 
• **Example: **The industry needs to standardise its practices for better efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Illustrate** (उदाहरण देना): To explain or make something clear by using examples, charts, pictures, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher illustrated the point with a diagram on the board.
